BiblicalUsage: Offspring is the line itself, and the Bible threatens it and protects it in the same breath. Abraham swears he will not deal falsely with Abimelech, his son, or his son's son; the wicked man shall have neither son nor nephew among his people; and God promises to cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the line is the stake: God guards the offspring of the faithful and cuts off the offspring of the proud. Abraham's oath covers his son's son, and Babylon's name is cut off with its remnant — the line is protected, and the line is ended.
